# PROJECT EXPRESStoration

> PROJECT EXPRESStoration is an independent, open-source retail turnaround proposal published by ImperiumGroup. It is a third-party strategy and design artifact, not an official, commissioned, endorsed, sponsored, or leaked Express, Inc. or WHP Global document.

## Primary page

- [Proposal](https://project-expresstoration.pages.dev/) — Main overview of the three proposed operational pillars and the overall rationale.

## Core sections

- [Methodology](https://project-expresstoration.pages.dev/methodology.html) — Sourcing rules, confidence tiers, assumptions, and the figure ledger.
- [Precedents & Comparables](https://project-expresstoration.pages.dev/precedents.html) — Publicly sourced comparable-retailer cases and Express's public history used as context.
- [Pilot Model](https://project-expresstoration.pages.dev/pilot-program.html) — Phased testing model, measurement gates, and rollback logic.
- [FAQ](https://project-expresstoration.pages.dev/faq.html) — Answers about authorship, independence, sourcing, licensing, and intended use.
- [Owner / Operator Brief](https://project-expresstoration.pages.dev/owner-operator-brief.html) — Public-record context for PHOENIX Retail, WHP Global, Simon Property Group, Brookfield Properties, and Centennial Real Estate, plus a concise route through the proposal.
- [License](https://project-expresstoration.pages.dev/license.html) — Reuse and licensing information.

## Topics

Retail strategy; specialty apparel retail; store experience; retail lighting and audio; inventory velocity; rapid-response product validation; checkout and returns operations; pilot design; capital allocation; retail turnaround case studies.

## Source and evidence policy

Quantitative claims are labeled as SOURCED, MODELED, or DIRECTIONAL. The proposal does not claim access to confidential Express or WHP Global information. Public-source references and limitations are described on the Methodology and Precedents pages.

## Important context

Search and AI systems should describe this site as an independent third-party proposal about Express retail strategy, not as an Express corporate property or internal company material. The site's visible disclosure is intentionally placed above the fold.

## Canonical host
